verification.note: OBI:0600047 'sequencing assay' is the best parent class for this schema node. Level 2 represents aligned sequencing data; no specific ontology term exists for this data processing level.
NCIT:C49189 'Primary Key' directly matches the use as a unique row identifier / primary key.
NCIT:C164052 'Aligned Sequence Read' is defined as 'the determination of the order of a set of sequenced nucleic acid fragments via alignment to a reference genome'. Matches aligned reads.
